scope: Guarded native model request lifecycle, trusted per-request stop contract, independent usage accounting and authoritative JDBC visibility

verification.skipReason: Optional real-provider test is not enabled

architecture.automaticCoverage: Guarded synchronous, asynchronous and streaming model calls, including native AI Service paths; one MODEL_REQUEST registration per native call, independent of UsageLimits
architecture.beforeDispatch: External register/start authority acknowledgement precedes native invocation and usage dispatch; unused preparation and unsent usage holds close on refusal
architecture.delivery: Evidence classification precedes asynchronous result delivery; late streaming terminal callback can confirm work without delivering a cancelled response
architecture.defaultProof: A valid complete native ChatResponse confirms only the logical MODEL_REQUEST; cancellation of transport or Future does not prove remote generation stopped
architecture.hostExtension: ModelTerminationContract binds the actual governed request to trusted provider-specific stop acknowledgement; optional Spring beans centralized in default AiServiceOptions
architecture.replication: Model records reuse shared external-work ownership, bounded metadata publication, sticky unknown state and JDBC checkpoints; cancellation fact published before a racing exit receipt
architecture.shutdown: Bounded two-second drain for already queued metadata; no durable node outbox

httpScenarios.transport: Real loopback HTTP and Java HttpClient
assertions: Client delivery cancelled while synthetic server job continues ticking
UNKNOWN retains active=1 and freezes shared root
Authenticated stop waits for actual server job exit
Request tombstone blocks delayed creation after stop
Full receipt releases active slot and healthy parent can continue
Synchronous native request is revoked and actual synthetic job stops
Physical stop can be confirmed while heldTokens=150 and uncertainCalls=1 remain

independentProcessScenarios.topology: Two independent SDK JVMs using LangChain4j official OpenAI client, loopback HTTP status/provider endpoints and H2 JDBC authority
normal: Synchronous and asynchronous complete responses produce two MODEL_REQUEST entries
Workers exit normally; fresh JDBC registry observes full confirmation and active=0
killed: SDK JVM forcibly killed during dispatched HTTP generation
Fresh JDBC registry observes UNKNOWN, active=1, sticky external_execution_unconfirmed
Sibling request denied before another provider dispatch
Dispatched unknown usage retains 150 Token hold

additionalRegression.spring: GovernanceAutoConfigurationTest.hostMeterAndTerminationBeansApplyToGeneratedServices validates real Boot wiring and native service invocation
additionalRegression.receiptRace: ExternalExecutionTest.earlyExitReceiptPublishesCancellationBeforeCompletion deterministically executes exit publication before cancellation publication
additionalRegression.existingRegression: Streaming error cause remains stream_failed; fixed Java process cancellation remains CANCEL_CONFIRMED after actual PID exit

privacy: External execution RPC and persistent work rows contain identifiers/state/evidence rather than model request/response content or provider credentials; all fixture identities and data are synthetic
limitations: Complete response confirms logical request scope, not provider OS cleanup or final billing
No production vendor stop API or real billing was verified; host contract must supply request-bound trustworthy evidence and prevent delayed start after stop acknowledgement
No persistent node receipt outbox; process/network failure can lose terminal evidence
Only H2 and local test transport were verified; production IAM, database HA/failover and platform isolation remain open
Logical document versions and P1 injection, reliable side effects, audit governance, approvals and supply-chain work remain in the active plan
